Summary.en: Applies a functionality (or attribute changes) to a target element ONCE AT LOAD while a NUMERIC comparison between an element-placeholder value and a reference holds. Registers no event listener: it reads the value the element placeholders resolved at render time, compares it as a number, and applies the matching _T_/_F_ branch immediately. Use it for a load-time more/less-than visibility toggle driven by an EP result (e.g. an array .length), avoiding a change event.
Summary.de: Wendet eine Funktionalität (oder Attributänderungen) auf ein Zielelement EINMAL BEIM LADEN an, solange ein NUMERISCHER Vergleich zwischen einem Element-Platzhalterwert und einer Referenz erfüllt ist. Registriert keinen Event-Listener: Er liest den zum Renderzeitpunkt aufgelösten Platzhalterwert, vergleicht ihn als Zahl und wendet den passenden _T_/_F_-Zweig sofort an. Für einen Ladezeit-Sichtbarkeitswechsel (mehr/weniger als) auf Basis eines EP-Ergebnisses (z.B. einer Array-.length) ohne change-Event.
Summary.it: Applica una funzionalità (o modifiche agli attributi) a un elemento di destinazione UNA SOLA VOLTA AL CARICAMENTO finché è soddisfatto un confronto NUMERICO tra un valore di elemento-placeholder e un riferimento. Non registra alcun listener di eventi: legge il valore risolto al momento del rendering, lo confronta come numero e applica subito il ramo _T_/_F_ corrispondente. Da usare per un toggle di visibilità al caricamento (più/meno di) guidato da un risultato di EP (es. una .length di array) senza dover aspettare un evento change.

Parameter.Candidate: The value to compare. Use an element placeholder that resolves to a NUMBER or numeric string, e.g. { JSON.Path > { bayvis.leistungsansprechpartner > 25439 } ; length } (the EP is resolved into this parameter at load), or a numeric literal. An empty value never fulfils the condition.
Parameter.Reference: The numeric threshold the candidate is compared with, e.g. 1. May itself be an element placeholder that resolves to a number; a literal is parsed with Number().
Parameter.Mode: GT (greater than), GTEQ (at least / greater than or equal), LT (less than), LTEQ (at most / less than or equal), EQ (exactly) or NEQ (not equal). The enum values are GTEQ/LTEQ - GTE/LTE are invalid.
Parameter.Target: The element whose attributes are changed - a dot-prefixed CLASS selector (e.g. .coMehrfachZuordnungHinweis), resolved inside the tagged element's container; never an #id selector.

Candidate.default: The value to compare, supplied as an element placeholder that resolves to a NUMBER or numeric string (e.g. { JSON.Path > <EP> ; length }) or as a numeric literal.

Reference.default: The numeric threshold the candidate is compared with (e.g. 1); may itself be an element placeholder; a literal is parsed with Number().

Mode.default: GT (greater than), GTEQ (at least), LT (less than), LTEQ (at most), EQ (exactly), NEQ (not equal).

Target.default: Dot-prefixed CLASS selector of the element to change, resolved in the tagged element's container (never an #id selector).
